_comment: Production dependencies must be under one of these SPDX licences (for 'A OR B' one allowed alternative is enough; 'A AND B' needs both). Anything else fails scripts/license-audit.mjs unless listed in 'exceptions' with a reason and, where the risk is shipping the code, a bundleMarker that must be ABSENT from the built bundle. CC-BY-4.0 (data, e.g. caniuse-lite) is permitted but requires attribution in the shipped app's third-party notices.

exceptions.name: @codesandbox/nodebox
exceptions.reason: Transitive dependency of @codesandbox/sandpack-client. Its licence limits use to internal-business or non-commercial purposes, so it is replaced by apps/web/src/lib/nodebox-stub.ts in the production bundle.
